findings.description: The KMS key does not have automatic key rotation enabled (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), which increases the risk of prolonged exposure if the key material is ever compromised, since rotation is a defense-in-depth control against key compromise over time.

No key policy is defined for the KMS key, which means it will fall back to the default policy granting full access to the root account/IAM principals with permissions, potentially allowing overly broad access to the key used to encrypt logs.
